title: It is Okay for  me -  will buy another probably. Update on rip
text:
It is Okay for me - will buy another probably. Update on rip. It is not like a regular backpack but a laundry bag with back-like pack straps. OK. I am disabled and currently forced to stay in a second floor room. There is no laundry up here so I have to drag mine out, drag it back in. In addition, dragging groceries and anything else I am forced to bring in here. It is a little difficult to get in to if you are disabled. I am getting the hang of it. It is better than trying to deal with multiple laundry bags or grocery bags and a cane/walker. I want another so that if I forget to bring it down empty I still have one down in my car for a haul up... only took off the star because like another poster said, would be better if the straps were adjustable.

UPDATE - one strap has ripped. I am an arthritic older women so I am not exactly hauling major weight in it but laundry once a week and grocery 2-3 times. I am pretty sure I can sew it up. And I had ordered another so I have a spare while waiting to mend the other. Still not bad for the price but say college guys or girls that want to haul some heavy loads - take care it is not heavy duty.
